facts.text: Creighton is an unincorporated community in East Deer Township, 18 miles northeast of Pittsburgh, along the Allegheny River.
The Pittsburgh Plate Glass Company, now PPG Industries, was founded in Creighton in 1883, becoming the first financially successful U.S. plate glass manufacturer.
Creighton's riverfront lowlands rise to steep bluffs, with elevations from 740 to over 900 feet, creating a narrow valley prone to flooding during high river stages.
Future revitalization plans aim to honor Creighton's historic glass industry by offering tours, educational programs, and community events that connect past and present.
The community's boundaries follow Pool 3 of the Allegheny River, influencing navigation and positioning within the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Locks and Dams system.
Creighton’s climate averages 52°F annually, with about 38 inches of precipitation spread evenly across 132 rainy days each year.
